name: Chugach
crosswalk_note: Split 2019-01-02 into Chugach Census Area (02063) and Copper River Census Area (02066). Mapped to 02063 for the join; Copper River's earlier total remains folded into the mapped row.

name: Hoonah-Angoon
crosswalk_note: Reconstituted as Hoonah-Angoon Census Area 2007-06-20 when Skagway consolidated into its own municipality (02230). Mapped to 02105 for the join., Renamed Skagway-Hoonah-Angoon in 1992 after Yakutat became a separate borough (02282), then reconstituted as Hoonah-Angoon in 2007 after Skagway became its own municipality (02230). Mapped to 02105 for the join.

name: Petersburg
crosswalk_note: Split 2013-01-03 into Petersburg Borough (02195) and Wrangell City and Borough (02275). Mapped to 02195 for the join; a population share belongs with 02275.

name: Prince of Wales-Hyder
crosswalk_note: Split 2008-05-19: Outer Ketchikan portion annexed by Ketchikan Gateway Borough (02130), Meyers Chuck portion into Wrangell City and Borough (02275), remainder renamed Prince of Wales-Hyder. Mapped whole to 02198 for the county join; a small population share is technically in 02130/02275.

name: Gallatin
crosswalk_note: Montana's Yellowstone National Park county-equivalent was dissolved in 1997. Mapped to Gallatin County for continuity with the Phase 1 crosswalk; a small population share belonged with Park County.

name: Alleghany
crosswalk_note: Reverted from independent city to town and absorbed into Alleghany County effective 2001-07-01. Direct successor for the join.

name: Bedford
crosswalk_note: Reverted from independent city to town and absorbed into Bedford County effective 2013-07-01. Direct successor for the join.
